scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by an analytical proof and supplementary exact/numerical tests. No external independent proof verification, formal proof assistant certification or novelty priority proof is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact fixed-iid worst-direction one-step squared-error result only; restricted to real invertible normalized rows with the specified Gram and strictly positive hub correlation. Prior generalized SDP and E-design theory cover the general formulation. Specialized earlier equivalent subfamily possible; numerical checks are not proofs. No independent validation.
title: Sharp optimal row sampling for one-hub equicorrelated Kaczmarz systems
